PreassignedFareProduct.Name: IJPP mesečna imenska vozovnica Ljubljana - Maribor
PreassignedFareProduct.Description: Combined bus + rail named monthly ticket on the relation Ljubljana - Maribor, valid on all IJPP operators; higher-type trains need a supplement.

SupplementProduct.Name: Dodatek za vlake višje vrste (IC, MV, EC, EN, ICS)
SupplementProduct.Description: Per-trip supplement: EUR 2.00 bought before boarding at a sales point or ticket machine (priced below), EUR 4.00 on board. Bought for a whole relation it also covers a change to another higher-type train. Monthly-ticket holders can buy the flat-rate monthly supplement instead.

SupplementProduct.Name: Mesečni dodatek za vlake višje vrste za splošne IJPP vozovnice
SupplementProduct.Description: Flat-rate monthly supplement for general IJPP tickets (also IJPP tickets for over-65s and pensioners): unlimited use of higher-type trains (IC, MV, EC, EN, ICS) for the month. EUR 30.00; sold only at a passenger ticket office, not on board. Annual variant EUR 240.00; for subsidised IJPP school tickets EUR 10.00 / EUR 80.00 (not modelled separately).

CappedDiscountRight.Name: IJPP - vozovnica velja na celotnem območju RS (price cap = nationwide validity)
CappedDiscountRight.Description: The monthly price rises with distance only up to the 15-20 km band (EUR 70.00) and is flat beyond it; the DUJPP price list marks these capped cells as valid on the whole territory of Slovenia. Hence the Ljubljana - Maribor monthly ticket gives unlimited travel throughout Slovenia for the month (no MaximumDistance). Encoding this as a CappingRule is an interpretation.

PreassignedFareProduct.Name: Vikend družinska vozovnica, do 5 oseb
PreassignedFareProduct.Description: Group ticket for up to 5 persons, one of them a child up to 15: unlimited trips on any relation in Slovenia on Saturdays, Sundays and non-working holidays, at most 5 consecutive days. A 10-person variant costs EUR 30.00 (not modelled separately).
